note: The model's recorded score, and exactly what produced it -- #97. `python evals/score.py --check-prompt` fails when prompt.py no longer sends what `prompt` and `schema` record, so a prompt change has to arrive with a re-measured number in the same change. It can tell that a number was recorded under the current prompt; it cannot tell whether the number is honest. Nothing compares the percentages here against a run -- the model never runs in CI -- and their caveats are in docs/evals.md sections 7 and 9. evals/README.md says how to update this file.
